object_description: compact slim bar placed in the middle of the plot dividing it into a front and a garden zone
design_condition: the bar sits in the middle of the plot, dividing the open space into a front zone and a garden zone and continuing the green belt from the protected tree group to the street

positive: The compact body creates generous outdoor spaces despite a topographically difficult setting
It leaves potential for another building along the street
Continuing the green belt from the protected tree group creates the garden-like playground
The authors recognise the high qualities of the environment and integrate them optimally
The outdoor space towards the path remains assigned to the kindergartens
Towards the forest an outdoor space usable by both day care and kindergartens is created
A gently terraced outdoor space towards the street complements the diverse offering
The body and facades have beautiful proportions
The closed front sides contrast with long sides whose different treatment reveals the use behind
Covered entrances and extended outdoor equipment rooms make the individual kindergartens recognisable
The different entrances achieve the separation desired by the operator
Two staircases at the front and access axes through the cloakrooms offer ideal internal connections
The well thought-out wooden column and ceiling system enables flexible future room layouts
The project adheres to all boundary distances and the linden tree can be preserved
negative: The large glass surfaces risk an indoor climate controllable only with complex building technology
With the awnings down, artificial lighting may be necessary inside
The structure violates the distance from the forest, so an exception is necessary
The slim bar has to be pushed too tightly into the topography at the existing school building
The quality of the rearmost kindergarten and its group room suffers as a result
The parking arrangement shades the rear cloakroom, which is not optimal
Building and developing a basement is more complex than a ground-level arrangement of technical rooms
